platformDomain.description: The environment's platform domain (ADR 0042). Backstage is served at backstage.<platformDomain> and signs in against keycloak.<platformDomain> (ADR 0113).

gatewayClassName.description: The GatewayClass the portal's own Gateway uses, which kore derives from the ingress feature flag and passes in. With none set the chart renders no route.

issuer.description: The ClusterIssuer that signs the portal host's certificate.

sharedGateway.description: The shared platform Gateway the portal also attaches a route to, which kore passes only while platform-shared-gateway is on (ADR 0133). The route host is backstage.<domain>. Without it no shared route renders.

domain.description: The platform organization's domain, <organizationId>.<platformDomain>, which the shared Gateway's wildcard listener serves.

image.description: The sign-in proxy image, by digest.
